links.outcome: Report turnaround time and time to treatment before vs after AI detection and triage
links.effect: Median report turnaround 0.66 h vs 24.68 h; time to treatment 0.98 h vs 28.05 h (both P < .001); reported iPE prevalence 2.5% vs 0.8%.
links.quote: In conclusion, the use of AI for detection and triage of iPE in clinical practice resulted in an increased detection rate of iPE and significantly shorter report turnaround time and time to treatment for patients with cancer-associated iPE.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-world clinical implementation (pre- vs post-implementation) of an AI triage algorithm on workflow outcomes, including report turnaround time and time to treatment for cancer patients with incidental pulmonary embolism.
